title: Refresh group membership safely
goal: Add one supplementary group while retaining another; compare old and fresh process credentials.
challenge: Create locked ll-u3 and two disposable groups ll-u3keep/ll-u3team. Preserve keep when adding team. Demonstrate the old process retains old groups and a fresh process receives new groups. Use only bounded, tracked practice processes.

steps.command: ! getent passwd ll-u3 && ! getent group ll-u3 && test ! -e /home/ll-u3 && sudo useradd -m -U -s /bin/bash ll-u3
steps.explanation: Fail closed if this disposable name or home exists. -m creates a home from /etc/skel; -U creates a primary group; no password is set.
steps.expected: Fresh account ll-u3, same-named primary group, home and Bash shell. A nonzero status/collision means stop setup.

steps.command: ! getent group ll-u3keep && ! getent group ll-u3team && sudo groupadd ll-u3keep && sudo groupadd ll-u3team && sudo usermod -aG ll-u3keep ll-u3
steps.explanation: Guard collisions. -aG appends; -G without -a replaces the supplementary list.
steps.expected: ll-u3 has its primary group and keep supplementary group.

steps.command: sudo runuser -u ll-u3 -- bash -c 'id -Gn > "$HOME/old.before"; sleep 30; id -Gn > "$HOME/old.after"' & holder=$!
steps.explanation: Start one old-credentials process, bounded to 30 seconds. holder is the launcher PID; do not guess a PID or signal other users.
steps.expected: Old process captures its groups; it will exit by itself.

steps.explanation: Wait until this exists before changing membership. If missing, retry this inspection, not setup.
steps.expected: keep present, team absent; ready evidence from the old process.

steps.command: sudo usermod -aG ll-u3team ll-u3; id ll-u3; sudo runuser -u ll-u3 -- id
steps.explanation: Database and newly initialized credentials see the addition. Existing processes are unchanged.
steps.expected: Fresh process has keep and team; primary group unchanged.

steps.explanation: Wait for the exact launcher to finish; the old process group list remains old. A new login/session is needed for existing interactive users.
steps.expected: Old after still lacks team. Logout/login refreshes credentials; reboot is unnecessary.

hints: Do not use usermod -G team alone: it would remove keep.
id USER reads current database membership; id inside the old process shows cached credentials.
Wait for old.before before the edit and old.after after the bounded job ends.
review: Retain old.before/old.after and a fresh id; keep remains present and team appears only in the fresh process.
All practice processes have finished before account/group cleanup.
coverage: LPIC-1 107.1 supplementary membership changes. Partial coverage; original material, self-review only. No automatic assessment or full LPIC preparation.
